request.objective: Test one bounded correction loop using a deliberately incomplete initial candidate, not a real product change. The final accepted artifact must meet the same acceptance criteria on both reviews. For the executor only: on the first execution, when no Bounded remediation projection section is present, write exactly INITIAL followed by one LF into 40_Develop/coordinator/runtime/remediation-verification.txt; this is an intentionally deficient test fixture and is not expected to pass review. If the runtime provides a Bounded remediation projection, independently verify its defect against the acceptance criteria and correct the file to exactly FINAL followed by one LF. Reviewer: inspect the actual file against the final acceptance criteria, report the initial content mismatch honestly as a typed finding, and approve only once the final criteria hold. Do not fabricate findings or approve INITIAL. Do not access any other file or external service.
acceptanceCriteria: The final accepted file consists of the UTF-8 bytes 46 49 4e 41 4c 0a (FINAL followed by exactly one LF), with no BOM or other content. INITIAL is an intentionally incomplete fixture and must not be approved.
